title: Ensure Windows launcher owner-stop reaches the MSYS and Cargo test tree
outcome: Stopping an owned Windows launcher run also stops its owned MSYS/Cargo/test descendants, while preserving interrupted evidence and leaving the host and other owners' processes untouched.
acceptance: A Windows regression demonstrates the observed ancestry escape through Git Bash/MSYS and proves that the supported owner-stop path terminates all processes belonging to the selected run.
Stopping a selected run preserves its original artifacts and records interruption without rerunning tests or granting a passed verification record.
The owner-stop path verifies process/run ownership and does not stop the TermAl host or another run.
